title: Six weeks to the exam

off.2026-11-11: Skipped · admin and the Germantown drive

exam.shape: Theory 20 · Wiring & Protection (100–285) 20 · Wiring Methods (300–398) 12 · Equipment (400–490) 6 · Special Occupancies 4 · Special Equipment 2 · Communications (700–830) 6
exam.source: PSI Maryland Master and Journeyperson Electrician bulletin, read 2026-11-07

ready: Ready is both benchmarks (Dec 6 and Dec 13, in the exam's shape) at 80% or better. Both 74–79: sit it anyway and taper. Either under 72: move the date.

weeks.label: Week 1
weeks.theme: Article 250 Parts I–II, and the first theory night

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.theme: Electrodes and equipment grounding, theory, box fill, the dwelling load

weeks.label: Week 3
weeks.theme: Art 230, raceway fill, wiring methods, voltage drop, theory

weeks.label: Week 4
weeks.theme: Conductor sizing, Art 240, motors, theory review

weeks.label: Exam week
weeks.theme: Taper. Sit it when PSI gives the date.

weeks.label: Holding
weeks.theme: Only if the date comes later: a sim a Sunday, an hour a night

days.title: Restart night
steps: Sim Exams book, Ch 2 How to Use the NEC (printed p7–8). Read it once, 15 min.
Sim Exams book, Ch 4 test-taking tips (printed p59–62). 5 min.
Check the code book against PSI's rules: tabs must be permanent plastic (Avery Swift Tabs or Redi-Tag), not Post-it flags; highlighter is fine, pen anywhere in the book is not; nothing loose inside.
days.note: Light night. Sim A tomorrow, 4 hours, start by 9 am.

days.title: Sim #1 · baseline
days.note: Mike's Exam A, 100 questions, 4 hours. Whatever the score, it is the starting line. On paper, note the clock at every tenth question: your real pace, from day one.
steps: Start by 9 am. Four hours on the clock, 2020 code book only, phone face down.

Checkpoints: 100 questions in 240 minutes is 2.4 minutes each. At 60 min you have answered 25; at 120 min, 50. Behind that, best-guess the flagged ones and move. No scheduled break; the clock runs if you leave the room.

Grade when time is called, not before. Then read every miss; press Rewatch where it offers one. Theory misses first: open the Exam Prep unit the reference names and work that example on paper. Review stops at 60 min: the misses are in the notebook, and the notebook nights redo them.

days.title: Art 250 Part I · the effective ground-fault current path

video.say: Mike opens 250: scope, 250.4(A)(1)–(5) and (B), what grounding is for

steps: Highlight 250.4 and 250.6 in the 2020 book as he reads them: blue over the heading, yellow after shall, red highlighter under the numbers. Highlighter only, never pen.

days.title: Art 250 Part I · objectionable current, connections

video.say: 250.6 objectionable current, 250.8 connection methods, 250.10, 250.12

steps: Finish highlighting Part I.

days.title: Art 250 Part II · service grounding, bonding jumpers, separately derived systems

video.say: 250.24: where the grounded conductor lands and why nowhere else
250.32: a second building on a feeder

steps: The quiz is last night's twenty again, now that the video has taught them, plus the six that finish Part II. Each night's quiz covers that night's video or earlier, never ahead of it.
Work five supply-side bonding jumper sizes from Table 250.102(C)(1). Highlight 250.24(A)(1), (A)(5), (B), (C); 250.28(D); 250.30(A); 250.32(A), (B)(1).
The generator video (250.30 for generators, 19 min) is for the drive, not tonight.

days.title: Theory I · Ohm's law, Watt's law, the formula wheel

video.say: Unit 12 Ohm's law
Unit 13 Watt's law
Unit 29 the formula wheel

steps: Sim #1 said theory 2 of 10, and theory is 20 of the 70 on the real exam; the next sim has twenty of them. Pen and paper the whole hour: every example Mike works, you work first. E = I × R, P = E × I, and the wheel for the rest.

days.title: Sim #2 · Maryland shape
days.note: 70 questions in PSI Maryland's own proportions, 3½ hours. 49 right passes the real one. Twenty of them are theory, mixed in with the rest.
steps: Start by 9 am. 3½ hours on the clock, 2020 code book only, phone face down.

Checkpoints: 70 questions in 210 minutes is 3.0 minutes each. At 60 min you have answered 20; at 120 min, 40. Behind that, best-guess the flagged ones and move. No scheduled break; the clock runs if you leave the room.

Grade when time is called, not before. Then read every miss; press Rewatch where it offers one. Theory misses first: open the Exam Prep unit the reference names and work that example on paper. Review stops at 60 min: the misses are in the notebook, and the notebook nights redo them.

days.title: Art 250 Part III · electrodes and the grounding electrode conductor

video.say: 250.50 to 250.53: every electrode, the rod rules

steps: Work five Table 250.66 problems, with the 6 AWG rod cap and the 4 AWG concrete-encased cap. Highlight 250.52(A), 250.53(A), 250.64, 250.66, 250.68.

days.title: Art 250 Parts V–VI · the bonding jumper and the equipment grounding conductor

video.say: 250.102: bonding jumpers, Table 250.102(C)(1)
250.118: what counts as an EGC
250.122 and its table

pages.what: Parts IV to VII: read 250.92, 250.94, 250.104, 250.146, 250.148 from the star list

steps: Five bonding jumper sizes, supply side by 250.102(C)(1); five EGCs by Table 250.122, two with the proportional upsizing in (B). 250.140 in your 2020 book is the main paragraph and its exception, not an (A). The rest of Parts IV to VII is lookup: highlight it from the star list, do not watch it.

days.title: Theory II · series and parallel circuits

video.say: Unit 14 series circuits
Unit 15 parallel circuits

steps: On paper: resistors in series add; in parallel 1/R = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + 1/R3, and equal resistors in parallel are R ÷ n (three 5 Ω in parallel is 1.66 Ω). Voltage divides across series resistors by their share of the resistance.

days.title: Box fill and pull boxes · 314.16, 314.28

video.say: Unit 2 whole: Table 314.16(A), 314.16(B), then 8× straight, 6× angle and U pulls

steps: Work five box fills with mixed sizes, a device yoke and an EGC, and three pull boxes: straight, angle, several raceways on one wall. Highlight 314.16(A), (B)(1)–(5), 314.28(A)(1)–(3).

days.title: Dwelling load · the standard method, Table 220.55

video.say: Unit 6, first half

steps: Work example 6.13 start to finish on paper before Mike finishes it. In the 2020 book the lighting load is 220.12 and the demand table is Table 220.42. PSI's own sample question is a range off Table 220.55: do three of those.

days.title: Theory III · alternating current

video.say: Unit 17 AC fundamentals: frequency, peak and RMS, phase

steps: On paper: RMS = peak × 0.707, peak = RMS × 1.414. The quiz is the rest of parallel circuits from the last theory night; Unit 17's own questions come on the next one.

days.title: Sim #3
days.note: Mike's Exam B, 100 questions, 4 hours: the one code-wide stress test. Heavier on Chapters 5–8 than Maryland is.
steps: Start by 9 am. Four hours on the clock, 2020 code book only, phone face down.

Checkpoints: 100 questions in 240 minutes is 2.4 minutes each. At 60 min you have answered 25; at 120 min, 50. Behind that, best-guess the flagged ones and move. No scheduled break; the clock runs if you leave the room.

Grade when time is called, not before. Then read every miss; press Rewatch where it offers one. Theory misses first: open the Exam Prep unit the reference names and work that example on paper. Review stops at 60 min: the misses are in the notebook, and the notebook nights redo them.

days.title: Article 230 · services

pages.what: Art 230, no video tonight: read it with the book open

steps: 230.2 number of services, 230.6 outside a building, 230.9 clearances, 230.24 overhead clearances, 230.42 sizing, 230.43 wiring methods, 230.70–230.72 the disconnect, 230.79 ratings, 230.85 emergency disconnect, 230.90 overload protection.
Highlight the whole article from its ★ list.

days.title: Theory IV · power factor, series-parallel

video.say: Unit 20 true power, power factor, apparent power
Unit 16 series-parallel circuits

steps: On paper: PF = W ÷ VA; VA = E × I, × 1.732 for three-phase. Work every example before Mike does. The quiz is Unit 17, from the last theory night.

days.title: Raceway fill · Chapter 9 and Annex C

video.say: Unit 1, first half: Tables 1, 4, 5 and Annex C

steps: Work six fills: three straight from Annex C, three with mixed sizes through Tables 4 and 5. Note 7: round up at 0.8. Note 4: nipples at 60%. Wireways are 20% (376.22). Tab Annex C by raceway type (permanent tabs).

days.title: Wiring methods · Art 300 and the cable and raceway articles (no video)
steps: Every 3xx article is numbered alike: .10 uses permitted, .12 not permitted, .24 bends, .30 support. Learn that once and twelve of the seventy are lookups.
Highlight 300, 320, 330, 334, 344, 352, 358 from their ★ lists.

days.title: Voltage drop · the formula

video.say: Unit 5 whole: circular mils, Table 8, 2KID/CM and the three-phase 1.732

steps: Work six: three single-phase, three three-phase, in volts and in percent. 3% and 5% are informational notes under 210.19 and 215.2.

days.title: Theory V · transformers and generators

video.say: Unit 24 transformers, the first 47 minutes: ratios, kVA, primary and secondary current
Unit 22 generators

steps: On paper: a 4:1 transformer divides voltage by 4 and multiplies current by 4; I = VA ÷ (E × 1.732) for three-phase. The quiz is Unit 20, from the last theory night.

days.title: Sim #4 · Maryland shape
steps: Start by 9 am. 3½ hours on the clock, 2020 code book only, phone face down.

Checkpoints: 70 questions in 210 minutes is 3.0 minutes each. At 60 min you have answered 20; at 120 min, 40. Behind that, best-guess the flagged ones and move. No scheduled break; the clock runs if you leave the room.

Grade when time is called, not before. Then read every miss; press Rewatch where it offers one. Theory misses first: open the Exam Prep unit the reference names and work that example on paper. Review stops at 60 min: the misses are in the notebook, and the notebook nights redo them.

days.title: Conductor sizing · insulation, terminals, ampacity, Art 310

video.say: Unit 3, first half: 110.14(C), 240.4, Table 310.16, correction and adjustment

pages.what: Unit 3 Parts A and B to 3.9

steps: Work six: pick from the 75°C column, then check against the corrected 90°C ampacity. In the 2020 book the insulation table is Table 310.4(A). Highlight Art 310 from its ★ list: 310.10, 310.12 and Table 310.12(A), 310.15(B), (C), (E), Table 310.16.

days.title: Article 240 · overcurrent protection, feeders and taps

video.say: Art 240 whole
Unit 3, the end: 215.2, 215.3, the tap rules of 240.21(B)

steps: Memorize 240.6(A). Highlight the whole article from its ★ list; 240.4(B), 240.4(D), 240.21(B) and (C), 240.24 first.

days.title: Motors · full-load current and conductors

video.say: Unit 4, the first 52 minutes: the FLC tables 430.248 and 430.250, conductors by 430.22, duty cycle

steps: Work three motors on paper: FLC from the table, never the nameplate, then the conductor at 125% by 430.22. Highlight Art 430 from its ★ list; tab Table 430.52 and the FLC tables.

drill.name: Lookup drill · mixed, say the article first

days.title: Motors · overloads, the breaker, the equipment grounding conductor

video.say: Unit 4, the middle: overloads 430.32, short-circuit and ground-fault protection by Table 430.52, the EGC by 250.122(D)

steps: Finish the three motors from the last motor night: the overload by 430.32, the breaker by Table 430.52 and 430.52(C)(1) Ex 1, the EGC.

drill.name: Lookup drill · mixed, say the article first

days.title: Motor feeders, air conditioning, transformers · Art 422, 424, 440

video.say: Unit 4, the end: feeders 430.24 and 430.62, air conditioning 440, transformers 450.3

steps: One feeder for three motors, conductor and breaker. Then highlight 422, 424 and 440 from their ★ lists: 422.10, 422.11, 422.16 cords, 422.31 disconnects, 424.3, 440.4(B), 440.14. Six of the seventy are Articles 400–490.

drill.name: Lookup drill · mixed, say the article first

days.title: Theory VI · every theory miss, then twenty mixed
days.what: Every theory miss from Sims #1 to #4 and the theory nights, redone on paper. Twenty of benchmark 1's seventy are theory.
steps: Then ten formula-wheel questions from Exam Prep Unit 29 (printed p105–107), each one written out: what is given, what is asked, which formula.

drill.name: Lookup drill · mixed, say the article first

days.title: Sim #5 · benchmark 1
days.note: Benchmark 1, in the exam's shape. 80 or better (56 of 70): on track. 74–79: sit it and taper. Under 72 (50): this score alone moves the date, today, while a reschedule is still free.
steps: Start by 9 am. 3½ hours on the clock, 2020 code book only, phone face down.

Checkpoints: 70 questions in 210 minutes is 3.0 minutes each. At 60 min you have answered 20; at 120 min, 40. Behind that, best-guess the flagged ones and move. No scheduled break; the clock runs if you leave the room.

days.title: All sim misses, cold
days.what: Every miss from Sims #1–#5. Redo them below without looking at the old answer; anything missed twice is red and comes back on the twice-missed night.
steps: Lookup drill: shut the book, then find the section of each sim miss in under 60 seconds. Time every one.

days.title: 250, 220 and 314 misses
days.what: Every grounding, load-calc and box-fill miss. For each, read the whole section in the 2020 book, not just the line. Then Exam Prep 6.13 once more, on paper.
steps: Lookup drill: Table 250.66, Table 250.102(C)(1), Table 250.122, Table 220.55 and its notes, Table 220.42, 314.16(B), 314.28(A), blind and timed.

days.title: Chapter 9, voltage drop and 310 misses
days.what: Every conduit-fill, voltage-drop and ampacity miss. Two fresh fills, two fresh drops, two corrections with both factors.
steps: Lookup drill: Ch 9 Tables 1, 4, 5, 8, Annex C, Table 310.16, 310.15(B)(1), 310.15(C)(1), blind and timed.

days.title: 240, 430, 440 misses
days.what: Every overcurrent, motor and AC miss. One full motor circuit, end to end.

days.title: Twice-missed, and theory
days.what: Everything red. Then the Theory questions below: 20 of the 70 are theory, the biggest block on the exam.
steps: Lookup drill: twenty random index words from the 2020 book, 60 seconds each.

days.title: Chapters 7 and 8 · emergency systems, fire alarm, where the rest lives

video.say: Art 700 to 700.12: tests, transfer equipment, wiring kept apart
Art 760 fire alarm

steps: Six of the seventy are Articles 700–830. In the 2020 book find, by the index and without the contents page: 700.10(B), 700.12, 701.12, 702.5, 725.121, 725.136, 760.41, 760.121, 800.24, 810.21. Mike's video is the 2023 Code: where a number differs, yours is the 2020 one in the book.
Read the scope (.1) of 700, 701, 702, 725, 760, 770, 800, 810, 820: one line each, so a question names its article.

drill.name: Lookup drill · mixed, say the article first

days.note: Benchmark 2, same shape. Both benchmarks 80 or better: sit it. Both 74–79: sit it; Mike's questions run harder than PSI's. Either under 72: the holding weeks below, and the date moves.

days.title: Taper, one hour
steps: 30 min lookup drill from the notebook, then 20 timed questions from any sim you have not re-sat. No new material.

days.title: Taper, one hour
steps: Same. Rework only what is still red in the Missed questions fold.

days.title: Taper, one hour
steps: Same. Call PSI once: arrival time, what ID they want. The bulletin gives an on-screen calculator and nothing else: use the computer's calculator on every quiz from today.

days.title: Taper, one hour
steps: Lookup drill only. Pack: the 2020 NEC, tabbed with permanent plastic tabs only (no Post-it flags, no paper inserts, nothing written in it, nothing loose), two forms of ID with the name on the application, the PSI confirmation.

days.title: Night before
steps: Sim Exams book Ch 4 (printed p59–62). Nothing else. No swim in the morning, or a short easy one done two hours before the slot. In bed early.

days.title: Exam day
steps: Breakfast. Arrive 30 minutes early. Read every question twice before touching the book. Flag the long ones and come back. 49 right is a pass.
